scope: Primary tag documentation and one predeclared generic offline node-policy hypothesis; no benchmark fit, policy sweep, graph query or app change.

policy.access: Use source-documented feature defaults only when no explicit car/general access key is present. Preserve existing mode precedence and every denial/unknown value.
policy.guards: Retain existing car/general/unknown conditionals, access qualifiers, dimensions, locks and opening hours. Gate/lift_gate/border_control/unknown features keep previous policy.
policy.independentRestrictions: A base-node change never clears any independent node-only restriction contributor.
policy.costs: No speed, price, signal, turn, reversal or barrier-delay change.
policy.scope: Generic source-tag interpretation prototype only; not current availability, lawful-trip, nationwide accuracy or app admission.

sources.observation: The mapped structure is designed to let wheeled vehicles cross while stopping animals; additional access tags can specify restrictions.
This tag describes a gap in a barrier and documents an access=yes default. Explicit access tags restrict it; a secured gate has a different tag.
This tag marks collection of a road-use charge. It is distinct from parking/admission fee barriers; toll avoidance is a separate routing choice.
More specific mode access overrides broader access. Feature defaults do not override explicit restrictions.
A gate may allow or restrict access. Access, locks, dimensions and other source tags supply additional constraints; no blanket open-gate assumption is made.
The documented default without access tags is generally motor_vehicle=private. This prototype preserves the previous explicit-permission policy for lift gates.

inferencesAndAssumptions: For these three vehicle-passable features only, a missing node access tag inherits the already eligible road rather than creating a new closure. This is a static engine interpretation, not an observation of legal or current road availability.
Toll roads remain usable under the existing app query semantics, with no new avoid-tolls option, payment eligibility or queue-delay model.
Retaining the previous node guards keeps all explicit/conditional/dimensional/lock/hour uncertainty closed. Independent source relation contributors remain separate and still block traversal.
